_note: 學習路徑內容建置第12批 #5／6：分詞構句——過去分詞表被動（eng.t_adv.special.participial-passive，學測級／高階）。句首的過去分詞片語帶被動意味，是被動子句的縮短：Written in 1990, the book became famous ＝ The book, which was written in 1990, became famous。主句主詞必須是『承受動作』的那個人/物，否則是懸垂分詞（dangling）。過去分詞＝被動（承受動作）；現在分詞 -ing＝主動（發出動作）。誘答以『用 -ing 變主動、主詞不符懸垂、用限定動詞/原形』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ptp_）。

units.title_zh: 分詞構句：過去分詞表被動（Written in 1990, …）
units.can_do: 我能用句首的過去分詞片語表達被動意味（Written in 1990, the book became popular），知道它是被動子句的縮短形，而且主句主詞必須是承受那個動作的人或物（否則是懸垂分詞），並能分辨過去分詞（被動）與 -ing 分詞（主動）。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型 The participial (passive) phrase
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A past participle (written, built, made) at the start of a phrase carries a passive meaning: the subject of the main clause receives the action — 'Written in 1990, the book became popular.'
claims.verification_ref: 句首過去分詞片語帶被動、主詞承受動作；Written in 1990, the book became popular；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The phrase is a shorter form of a passive clause: 'Written in 1990, the book...' = 'The book, which was written in 1990, ...'
claims.verification_ref: 分詞片語＝被動子句的縮短；Written in 1990, the book ＝ The book, which was written in 1990；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The subject of the main clause must be the person or thing that receives the action; otherwise the sentence is wrong (a dangling participle): 'Built in 1850, the bridge is still standing' (the bridge was built), not 'Built in 1850, the workers...'.
claims.verification_ref: 主句主詞須為承受動作者，否則懸垂分詞；Built in 1850, the bridge…（非 the workers）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A past participle shows passive (the subject receives the action); an -ing participle shows active (the subject does the action): 'Surprised by the news' (she was surprised) vs 'Surprising everyone' (it surprised everyone).
claims.verification_ref: 過去分詞＝被動（承受）、-ing＝主動（發出）；Surprised by the news vs Surprising everyone；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A sentence can start with a past participle phrase (Written..., Built..., Made...). It has a passive meaning: the subject that follows the phrase receives the action. Written in 1990, the book became popular. The book was written.
teach.zh_hint: 句子開頭放一個『過去分詞』片語（Written…、Built…、Made…），帶有『被動』的意味——表示後面的主詞是『被』怎麼樣。例如 Written in 1990, the book became popular.（這本書寫於 1990 年，後來很受歡迎。）書是『被寫』的。

teach.body: Written in 1990, the book became very popular.
teach.zh_hint: 這本書寫於 1990 年，後來非常受歡迎。book 是被寫的。

teach.body: This phrase is a shortened passive clause: Written in 1990, the book... = The book, which was written in 1990, ... So we use the past participle (passive), not -ing. The past participle is passive (it receives the action); the -ing participle is active (it does the action).
teach.zh_hint: 這個片語其實是一個『被動子句』的縮短：Written in 1990, the book… ＝ The book, which was written in 1990, …。所以用過去分詞（被動），不是 -ing。過去分詞＝被動（承受動作）；-ing 分詞＝主動（自己做動作）。

teach.body: Built in 1850, the bridge is still used today.
teach.zh_hint: 這座橋建於 1850 年，至今仍在使用。bridge 是被建的。

teach.body: Be careful: the subject of the main clause must be the person or thing that receives the action, or the sentence is wrong (a dangling participle). Built in 1850, the bridge is still standing. (correct); but not Built in 1850, the workers... (the workers were not built, so it is wrong).
teach.zh_hint: 要特別小心：主句的主詞一定要是『承受那個動作』的人或物，否則句子就錯了（叫懸垂分詞）。Built in 1850, the bridge is still standing.（橋是被建的，正確）；但不能說 Built in 1850, the workers…（工人不是被建的，就錯了）。

teach.body: Made in Japan, these cars are very reliable.
teach.zh_hint: 這些車在日本製造，非常可靠。cars 是被製造的。

practice.stem: 填入正確的分詞：____ in 1990, the book became a bestseller.（這本書寫於 1990 年，後來成為暢銷書）

distractor_rationales.Writing: Writing 是 -ing（主動），意思變成書自己在寫；書是被寫的，用過去分詞 Written。
distractor_rationales.Wrote: Wrote 是限定過去式動詞，不能這樣當分詞片語開頭。
distractor_rationales.To write: To write 是不定詞，意思不對；表被動用過去分詞 Written。

practice.feedback: 書是被寫的，用過去分詞表被動：Written in 1990, the book…。

practice.stem: 選出正確的主詞（承受『被建』的那個）：Built in 1850, ____ is still standing today.

distractor_rationales.the architect: 建築師是『設計』橋的人，不是被建的那個；主句主詞要是承受『被建』的 the old bridge。
distractor_rationales.the builder: 建造者是『蓋』橋的人，不是被建的那個；要用被建的 the old bridge。
distractor_rationales.the mayor: 市長不是被建的那個；要用被建的 the old bridge。

practice.feedback: 主句主詞要是承受動作（被建）的 the old bridge：Built in 1850, the old bridge is still standing。

practice.stem: 'Made in Japan, this car sells well' 這句話的意思是？
practice.answer: 這台車在日本製造，賣得很好
options: 這台車在日本製造，賣得很好
這台車製造了日本，賣得很好
這台車正在製造日本，賣得很好
這台車賣到日本，很受歡迎

distractor_rationales.這台車製造了日本，賣得很好: 過去分詞 Made 是被動，車是『被製造』，不是車去製造日本。
distractor_rationales.這台車正在製造日本，賣得很好: 那是現在進行主動的意思；Made 是被動過去分詞，表已被製造。
distractor_rationales.這台車賣到日本，很受歡迎: Made in Japan 是『在日本製造』（被動），不是賣到日本。

practice.feedback: Made in Japan＝被動（在日本製造），sells well＝賣得很好：這台車在日本製造，賣得很好。

practice.stem: 填入正確的分詞（她被大家稱讚）：____ by everyone, she felt very happy.

distractor_rationales.Praising: Praising 是 -ing（主動），意思變成她在稱讚別人；她是被稱讚，用過去分詞 Praised。
distractor_rationales.Praise: Praise 是原形動詞，不能這樣當分詞片語開頭。
distractor_rationales.To praise: 不定詞意思不對；表被動用過去分詞 Praised。

practice.feedback: 她是『被』稱讚，用過去分詞表被動：Praised by everyone, she felt very happy。

practice.answer: Surprised by the news, Tom could not speak.
options: Surprised by the news, Tom could not speak.
Surprising by the news, Tom could not speak.
Surprised by the news, the news shocked Tom.
Surprise by the news, Tom could not speak.

distractor_rationales.Surprising by the news, Tom could not sp: 有 by（被動）卻用 -ing（主動）矛盾；Tom 是被嚇到，用過去分詞 Surprised。
distractor_rationales.Surprised by the news, the news shocked: 主句主詞 the news 不是『被嚇到』的那個；承受者是 Tom，屬懸垂分詞。
distractor_rationales.Surprise by the news, Tom could not spea: Surprise 是原形，不能當分詞片語開頭；用過去分詞 Surprised。

practice.feedback: Tom 是被嚇到、主句主詞須是承受者：Surprised by the news, Tom could not speak。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Written in 1990, the book became very popular.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：句首過去分詞 Written 有沒有寫對、in 1990 後的逗號、主詞 the book、became very popular、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。句首分詞片語後略停、主句連貫、句尾下收。

lines.text: Painted last year, the house looks brand new.
lines.intonation: Painted last year 後略停、the house looks brand new 句尾下收

lines.text: Invited to the party, we felt very happy.
lines.intonation: Invited to the party 後略停、we felt very happy 句尾下收
